title.narrative: To achieve 80% reduction in the tuberculosis incidence rate and 90% reduction in the absolute number of tuberculosis death by 2030 as compared to the levels of 2015 - Nepal (16-Mar-2021-31-Jan-2025)

description.narrative: Nepal, Tuberculosis, Save the Children Federation, Inc. (STC HQ)This program has the following goals: To achieve 80% reduction in the tuberculosis incidence rate and 90% reduction in the absolute number of tuberculosis death by 2030 as compared to the levels of 2015. The objectives of this program are: To strengthen the health system and improve quality TB services under universal health coverage and ensure no affected family faces catastrophic costs due to TB by 2026. To strengthen community system for the management, advocacy, support and rights for TB patients in order to create an enabling environment and to detect and manage TB cases in 80% of local level by 2026. To strengthen surveillance system and implement regulatory mechanism. To strengthen and maintain an effective TB laboratory system. To enroll 80% of eligible childhood contact, introduce TB preventive therapy in vulnerable population, and strengthen infection control measures. To increase the annual notification number of drug susceptible TB up to 56,000 and drug-resistant TB up to 1500 by 2026. To develop and scale-up a comprehensive approach for engagement of private sector in TB care and prevention.. To address TB among people living with HIV, smokers, diabetic patients, and malnutrition people through collaborative framework and multisectoral approach. To maintain DS-TB treatment success above 90% throughout 2026 and increase DR-TB treatment success rate up to 85% by 2026

RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for NPL-T-SCFP03
Number of notified TB cases (all forms) contributed by non-national TB program providers - private/non-governmental facilities

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Completeness of facility reporting: Percentage of expected facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Outcome indicators targets and results for NPL-T-SCFP03
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases
